batting.name: AC Blizzard
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b S Nadeem

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b JR Hopes

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Y Venugopal Rao b M Morkel

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b MM Patel

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b MM Patel

batting.name: Y Nagar
batting.dismissal: c MM Patel b Harbhajan Singh

batting.dismissal: c A Symonds b KA Pollard

batting.name: S Nadeem
batting.dismissal: c MM Patel b KA Pollard

balls.text: an outstanding over from Ajit (a good day to lay off the jokes, then), the final ball is muscled to the leg side for one more single, just five off the final over with Pollard and Symonds at the crease, that's superb
outstanding fielding from Venugopal Rao at long-on, Pollard absolutely murdered that shortish one from Ajit, seemed to be headed for a certain boundary, Rao comes across in a jiffy to intercept
scythed to sweeper cover for a single
a perfect yorker from Ajit, powered towards long-off, Pollard should have been run-out, Ajit can't collect the simple throw from the deep though, Pollard was yards out, Ajit has his hands on his head
a  bouncer on legstump, Pollard ducks under
superb start from Ajit, a full and wide ball, chopped to the off side
Symonds comes down the track and slaps the ball to deep midwicket for a single

bizarre stuff this and the end of Rayudu, he looks to drive over extra cover off the back foot, his right leg slips and hits the stumps so he is hit wicket, and his attempted drive ends up as a catch to extra cover
four more for Rayudu, gets a big stride in and drives over the in-field, Warner races across from long-off, but can't get there
a yorker on the pads, lovely shot from Rayudu, wristy hit sends the ball scurrying to the deep backward square leg boundary, and with that Rayudu is third on the run-scoring charts for the season
length ball, Pollard blasts it down the ground, lands a few yards short of Warner
full and wide, Pollard had moved away from leg, can't get bat on ball
on the pads, whipped down to fine leg for a single
charges out and drives the ball down the gorund
flat and overpitched, Rayudu comes down the track and cracks it wide of long-off for four more, and that's his fifty
hello massive, Rayudu makes room and blasts the fired-in delivery over long-off
tucks this one wide of mid-on
punched back to the bowler
unlucky for Morkel, he pitches it up this time and has Morkel feeling for the ball outside off, gets a healthy edge, too healthy for Delhi's liking, wide of the keeper for four
bouncers are the way to go against Pollard, Morkel has decided, this one is down the leg side

a strange-looking shot from Rayudu, he was far across the stumps and looking to do a Tendulkar-like whip to the leg side, decides against it at the last moment, and taps the ball towards cover, raises his front leg as he plays the stroke
Pollard nearly gets a golden duck, the short one from Morkel, goes for the pull, top-edges it but it lands beyond mid-on
squeezed out towards point for a single to bring Pollard on strike, the crowd love him and the noise levels go up as Pollard takes guard

Morkel's day just got better, Rohit wanted to smash that back of length ball towards midwicket, gets an edge that sends it swirling to third man, this time the fielder holds on to it, no half-century for Rohit
a massive appeal for caught behind, it was a full ball outside off, Rohit backs away and is forced to reach across to, did he get a faint edge? hard to tell, Taufell didn't think so
driven down to long-off all along the ground
dropped, by Warner off all people, it should have been taken, a pull that goes just wide of him, nice height though he had to move to his right, gets his hands to it put can't pouch it
moves away from the stumps and drives it past extra cover
superbly timed by Rohit, Irfan saw the batsman skipping past leg and followed him, Rohit was cramped up but he still managed to drive the ball past the bowler
wayward from Irfan, a full toss outside off, Rohit wante to slam that through extra cover, takes the edge, past the keeper for four
Pathan bowls a superb yorker to start, squeezed towards point
Rohit's turning it on here, he brings up the 400th six of the season with a club towards cow corner, and that's 18 off the over
mistimes the pull this time, badly enough to land short of the fielder at deep midwicket
powerfully pulled by Rayudu, that one screamed to the boundary, deep midwicket didn't have too much ground to cover, but he could only watch the ball race by
cuts this one for a single
massive! Rohit Sharma celebrates the reprieve with a blast over the bowler's head, a length ball begging to be hit, Rohit sends that on to the roof of the Wankhede
missed the ball outside off

that looked out, Ajit was convinced it was, length ball coming in, looked to be hitting the stumps, perhaps the umpire thought the batsman was hit on the pads outside off, height wasn't an issue there, leg bye taken as the ball rolls to point, replays show that ball was hitting middle and leg
shortish ball outside off, flat-batted towards long-off, mistimed by Rayudu
another short ball, another attempted hook, another miss, superb over from Ajit so far
shortish and outside off, batsman looks to hook that one, can't get bat on it
shortish ball on off, Rohit opens the face and plays it fine towards third man
length ball outside off, slapped towards cover
plays the shot Rohit has played plenty of times today, the tap towards third man
Rayudu attempts something extravagant, shuffles across the stumps and looks to muscle a shortish ball to long leg
responds with a typical Morkel ball, back of a length on middle and off, guides it to third man
superb hit from Rohit,  skates out of the crease and wallops that over the bowler's head for a six, Morkel's poor day continues
good ball from Morkel, short of length again and on offstump, defended to the off side
too far outside off stump
shortish ball outside off, Rohit stands tall and guides the ball towards third man
a half-volley on the pads, an effortless flick sends the ball soaring over the watching Warner at the deep square leg boundary

launched towards long-on, should have been a single, the throw from the deep hits directly at the non-striker's end, batsmen sneak an extra run and when the ricochet is fielded and thrown to the keeper's end, there's no one backing up, so another run is gifted away, amateurish stuff from Delhi

Rohit survives, he goes for the pull, mishits it, it's in the air for a while and lands well short of the boundary, Warner races in from the rope but even he can't get to the ball which lands a yard short of him
driven along the ground, towards deep extra cover
length ball follows the batsman who was skipping down the leg side, pushed towards mid-off, Rayudu wanted one, Rohit rightly didn't, there's a direct hit, Rayudu's saved by the desperate dive
slashes the first ball behind backward point
comes down the track and slashes the ball towards deep point for a single
makes room and slices the ball towards cover
fuller on middle and leg, firmly driven towards long-off, batsmen wanted the second, but David Warner was on to that one in a flash and had the batsmen deciding against the second
short of length ball heading for legstump, defended to the on side
a belated call for a single after the ball is pushed towards short cover, a misfield prompts the decision to take a run, a direct hit would have been trouble
much more classical shot this time, gets on the front foot and drives through covers for four
what a shot that is from Rayudu, the ball was outside leg, Rayudu gets his front leg way down the leg side and then swivel to loft the ball to deep backward square leg
swing and a miss just outside off
dabs the ball towards midwicket and sneaks a single
short of length ball driven firmly but can't beat short extra cover
length ball angling in towards off, clipped towards cover
Rohit stands tall and drives elegantly through cover for a single
Rayudu gets on one knee as he looks to sweep, can't get hold of it, off the pads to the leg side
length ball heading for legstump, clipped towards square leg by Rohit
bends and dabs the ball towards short third man, Hopes misfields and gives away the single
eased towards long-on for a single
fires it wide outside off, left alone
shortish and on middle, Rohit once again gets up on his toes and guides the ball to third man, this one was very close to his body but he still managed to control the ball
opens the face to steer the ball down to third man for a single
Rayudu misses an outside off delivery
Yogesh Nagar throws himself spectacularly to his left at backward point but he can't get a hand on a screaming cut from Rayudu, powered to the boundary
short and outside off, Rohit stands tall and pushes the ball towards third man
shortish ball, Rayudu pulls off the back foot towards midwicket

the Delhi fight back continues, Blizzard is gone, he looks to club the ball over midwicket after clearing the front leg, he can only provide a low catch to Sehwag at midwicket, Sehwag nonchalantly tosses the ball to the ground after snaffling the catch
length ball, eased back to the bowler
whipped off the pads towards deep square leg
Blizzard mistimes the drive towards extra cover
length ball turns away, Rayudu hangs back and guides the ball towards third man
pushed towards square leg for a single
a wicket maiden from Irfan, super stuff, short of length and outside off, Rayudu looked to guide the ball to third man but can't connect
Rayudu charges down the track, and once more he can't play the aggressive shot he wants, blocked to the off side
Irfan getting the ball to seam in appreciably, Rayudu was initially going for the big hit, but the movement forces he defend the ball instead
short ball just outside off, lets it through to the keeper
Irfan's got the breakthrough, Tendulkar tries an ugly swipe, he misses as the ball keeps lower than he expects, and off stump is rocked back, relief for Delhi
Tendulkar tries a cute paddle from outside off, hit on the pads, there's a muted lbw appeal
slower offcutter from Ajit, nicely done, Blizzard fishes at it outside off and didn't get bat on it

Blizzard brings up the Mumbai fifty with a powerful hit, doesn't get it as long as he would have liked, it going very very high but lands beyond Morkle who was running back from mid-off, a few bounces before crossing the rope
short ball from Agarkar, Tendulkar pull but can't beat deep square leg
slightly short, bit of width, that's all Tendulkar needs, rocks back and slaps it behind point for four
length ball outside off, driven firmly towards mid-off
fullish ball on legstump, tucked towards square leg
Tendulkar punches the ball towards mid-on and sets off immediately for a single, there's a direct hit at the keeper's end but Blizzard's in
length ball on middle and leg, defended to the leg side by Tendulkar
Irfan appeals desperately for lbw, Tendulkar looks to nudge the ball down leg after moving across the stumps, hits the pads and that looked to be heading just down leg
swings down the leg side
Tendulkar attempts the paddle after shuffling across, can't get hold of it and the ball loops wide of the keeper on th eleg side
jags back in from just outside off, defended to the off side by Tendulkar
if Blizzard is going bonkers at the other end, Tendulkar is killing them softly, leans forward and plays a lovely on-drive, minimal effort, timing and placement again
those changes make no impact., Morkel gets hit for his fifth four of the over, on legstump, glanced fine by Blizzard, the Wankhede crowd is lapping it up
another four, four in the over, Blizzard continues to back away and carve the ball through off, this time behind point for four more
Blizzard again gets his front leg out of the way, and slams the ball over cover, bottom hand comes off as he plays that shot, third boundary of the over
a pick-up shot form Blizzard, whipped from leg stump behind backward square leg for four more, the normally economical Morkel leaking runs here
dabbed towards point this time
Blizzard doesn't look too graceful a batsman, he's been pretty effective though, gets his front leg well out of the way and flat bats an outside off ball past the bowler for four
Shot! this is what the Wankhede crowd came in, Tendulkar gets off the mark with a breathtaking drive between mid-off and extra cover, perfect placement, perfect timing
Irfan getting the ball to swing it in, short of length ball pitching just outside off, defended from the crease by Tendulkar
eased towards cover for a single, not too many singles get as big a cheer as this one, Tendulkar is now on strike
length ball outside off, beaten outside off as Blizzard looks to drive
keeps it full and just outside off this time, pushed towards cover
a hint of swing away from Pathan, fullish ball on middle, defended with a straight bat and no footwork by Blizzard
on the pads, clipped to midwicket for a single
an awkward pull from Blizzard, not timed very well but still has enough on it to go for four past midwicket
Blizzard backs away to make room, opens himself up and wallops the ball in front of point for a hard-hit four
bouncer from Morkel, but it is too far down the leg side, Mumbai are off the mark
superb start from Morkel, keeps it back of a length and sends this on leg stump, defended towards midwicket
keeps it on the same length, no room for Blizzard, defended down the track
short of length ball heading for middle, Blizzard is opened up as he looks to tuck the ball to the leg side

that's the end of the game, a couple of wickets for Pollard to close out the match, back of a length ball, the batsman moves across the stumps and looks to whips it over short fine leg, where that ever-present Munaf Patel takes  the catch that confirms the victory
Morkel is gone, Pollard gets a wicket, Delhi are nine down, Morkel wanted to slog that short of length ball into the crowd, can only get it as far as Andrew Symonds at deep midwicket
a short of length ball, swiped towards deep midwicket by Morkel

a no-ball, a slower ball gone wrong, another full toss over waist high, shortish and slapped for four over extra cover, since that is the second full toss above waist high, Malinga has to be taken out of the attack

Munaf redeeming himself after the early mistakes in the field, Malinga fired in a yorker that sneaked between the batsman and legstump, keeper can't collect, Munaf sprints across to cut that off just in time
dropped, punched back towards the bowler, who sticks out his right hand but the ball doesn't stick
overpitched ball, crunched towards long-off for a single to end the over
a full slower ball from Kulkarni, defended and the batsmen pinch a single
a short ball down the leg side
a dismissive swing sends the ball flying over wide mid-on for four
driven towards mid-off for a single
full and outside off, batsman can't reach it
nearly another one for Malinga, full and on legstump, defended by Morkel from the crease
there's signature Malinga delivery, a stunning yorker, 144kph, Irfan looks to whip it to the leg side, he misses and the ball crashes into legstump
full and outside off, sound of batting hitting the ground as the ball passes on its way to the keeper
a beamer from Malinga, who immediately apologies, Ajit was shaping to play to the leg side, but sees the high full toss and is hit on the bat as he crouches and looks to evade it
the slower ball from Malinga, 128kph, Ajit goes for the big swipe but is fixed by the change of pace
a yorker on middle stump, driven towards mid-off
flings it wide down the leg side, 146kph that one
overpitched ball on middle, Ajit backs away and daringly hits it through cover

Munaf has finally hold on to a catch today, Yogesh Nagar wanted to send his first ball into orbit, he sweeps and gets a top edge that flies towards Munaf at deep square leg, it is to Munaf's left  but he manages to pouch it, Mumbai's fielding coach Jonty Rohodes will be a happy man

the end of Hopes, communication breakdown there, Hopes skips away from leg and punches the ball to extra cover, he sets off for the quick single, Irfan takes a couple of paces and then decides he wants to hang around at the non-striker's end, Hopes is stranded halfway down the pitch
slapped down to long-off by Irfan for a single
shortish and on legstump, Irfan misses out on that as he looks to sweep it fine
four more, full ball from Harbhajan, swiped by Irfan past long-on for four more
length ball outside off, scythed over extra cover for four
another lucky boundary for Delhi, Hopes edges it over short third man for four
another full ball, dug out towards short third man, nearly a run-our, Hopes had given up but Malinga misses the direct hit
a yorker outside off, edged past the keeper for four
swats that one over midwicket, where the fielder leaps but the ball is too high for him
a full ball on legstump, Hopes squeezes it out to the leg side
short of length ball on offstump, defended to the off side
tucks the ball to square leg for a single to end the over
Ambati appeals in three phases for an lbw, but there was a huge inside-edge there
darts it down the leg side
pulls out the reverse-sweep, can't connect well, off the toe end towards point to being up his fifty
shortish ball outside off, dabbed towards point
looks to sweep this one but can't connect
fired in, defended off the front foot
tapped towards point for a single to end the over
short of length ball on offstump, defended to the off side
wonderful from Kulkarni, an inch-perfect yorker, Rao tries an ambitious shot, looks to guide the yorker to third man, gets a bottom-edge and the ball rolls on to the stumps, off-bail falls
a low full toss from Kulkarni, angling in towards middle, inside-edged towards the boot by Hopes, ball dribbles towards point
Hopes skips away from leg and dabs the ball towards point, Harbhajan fires in the throw at the non-striker's end, and concedes an overthrow
good start from Kulkarni, a short of length ball outside off, Hopes wanted to cut it but can't get bat on ball
massive! a length ball is powered by Rao over long-on for a huge six, Delhi capitalising on the weaker links in the Mumbai bowling
Delhi continue fight, a shortish ball on legstump, smashed in front of square leg for four
looks to steer this one down to third man, gets a leading edge and ball dies at the crease
forces this one towards deep midwicket, not in the gap
short ball, 114.7kph, Hopes looks to tuck that past point but can't connect
Symonds continues, length ball on middle and leg stump, wonderfully done by Hopes moves across and glances it fine for four, wonderful timing
four more, Pollard is proving very expensive here, this one slides down the leg side, helped along for a boundary to fine leg
bowled from wide of the crease, a length ball that is muscled towards long-on
Hopes continues to chance his luck and get away with it, short and well outside off, Hopes throws his bat at it, top-edged over the keeper for four
defended towards point for a single
107.5kph from Pollard, shortish and well outside off, slapped past Harbhajan at point, he's really struggling to move, seems to have some leg injury
fullish ball outside off, Rao wants to power it through mid-off, mistimes it towards the mid-on
nudged just behind square leg to take a single
just over Harbhajan in the circle, Hopes powers the ball over short midwicket,  can't beat Pollard in the deep
111kmh this time, worked to midwicket for a single
four more for Delhi,96.4kmh from Symonds, Rao gets on one knee and hammers that one to the square leg boundary
Rao opens the face looking to guide the ball to third man, can't connect
length ball to start from Symonds, whipped towards square leg
short of length and outside off, guided down to third man
driven firmly by the batsman towards point
a short ball is mowed by Hopes over wide mid-on for four more
swiped towards square leg for another boundary
same length, bit more width, slapped towards point
Pollard begins the over with a short of length ball outside off, guided down to third man
fired in full and flat, Hopes gets a thick inside-edge on to his boot, Hopes nearly falls over after playing that shot
length ball is defended off the front foot, a bit of an outside edge towards the off side
backs away to make room, taps the ball towards deep point
smashed, Rao charges down the track and blasts it past the bowler for four
tossed up by Harbhajan, fullish ball outside off, Rao looks to sweep but misses, Rayudu is hit on the shoulder as he looks to collect it
down the leg side, keeper can't collect
defended off the front foot
a yorker to finish the over, defended by Rao

dropped Munaf Patel was shaping to take that casually at fine leg, a 145kph bouncer, Hopes goes for the pull, Munaf moves across to intercept that, gets his hands on it but it bounces out, Malinga grins ruefully
slips in the bouncer, 144.8kph, Hopes chases after it outside off, he can't get bat on it
take that! the length ball on legstump is thumped over wide mid-on for four, superb from Hopes
reverts to the full length, a slower one as well, it was 127kmh low full toss, Hopes manages to keep it out, just about, Hopes smiles on surviving that one
and he starts with ... a length ball.. who expected that? defended to the leg side
short of length and outside off, Hopes attempts to cut this one as well, can't beat Pollard at backward point
this time he connects, Hopes isn't going down without a fight, he crashes that past point for four, not much footwork but solid connection
an outswinger, batsman goes for the cut but misses
a good-looking on-drive from Rao sends the ball scurrying towards deep midwicket
short of length ball, punched towards mid-on for a quick single

Hopes is going for it, he hooks a bouncer from Munaf, at least he tries to, it ends up as a top edge and luckily for him, unlike in the case of Sehwag, it flies fine of third man for a one-bounce four
defended towards extra cover, Symonds is lurking but the batsmen decide to risk the quick single, they make it in time
and another one, this time Hopes powerfully pulls the ball towards deep square leg, Munaf comes across in time but he makes a mess of the fielding effort
well, at least Delhi have managed a boundary in the Powerplay, pitched up this time, Hopes carves that over extra cover for four
shortish ball on legstump, off Rao's chest to the leg side and heads off to the non-striker's end
gets bat on this one, defended towards cover
have they changed the track they are playing on? Delhi's batsmen making every bowler look dangerous, a bit of away movement and Rao is beaten again
swings away from the batsman who is beaten
moves away from the batsman, Hopes lets that go
length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards cover
Hopes looks to scythe the ball through point but misses
Delhi batsmen struggling to middle the ball here, this time it is edged towards the off side
Kulkarni gets the ball to jag away this time, batsman looks to defend but the ball zips past the outside edge
curves this one in towards middle and leg, gets the leading edge as the batsman looks to play to the on side, flies towards third mna
length ball outside off, punched back to the bowler
length ball angling in, whipped in front of square leg
defended towards short cover
a lovely drive from Rao, steps nicely into the shot, gets himself three
the last ball of the over is safely negotiated, dabbed towards point

that seemed out, Rayudu is the picture of disbelief, he thinks there's big edge after the ball moves away and Ojha fishes at it outside off, there was a huge noise, Munaf was celebrating his second wicket in the over, only to turn back and see Hariharan is unmoved, Mumbai can't believe it, then Hariharan walks over to the square leg umpire and confers before giving it out, not sure what could have been discussed there
sprays it down the leg side
similar length, just outside off, guided down to third man
that one nips in sharply, the usual Munaf length, back of a length, outside off and swerves in so much that Rayudu has to dive to his left to collect
Ojha turns the ball to square leg for a single

This game is more or less over, Sehwag is gone, Munaf gets the big breakthrough first ball, a shortish ball on middle and off, Sehwag looks to pull it, gets a top edge which hangs in the air for a long time, Rohit made sure the converging fielders know it's his catch, he snaffles it
a bouncer to complete the wicket maiden, 143kmh, Ojha looks to play it to the leg side, but gets in on his arm guard and to the off side
an overpitched ball, the first really confident stroke from the batsman this over, gets forward and square-drives it towards backward point
keeps it short of a length, Ojha jumps as he defends the ball to the off side
short of length ball this time on offstump, defended towards backward point
it's wonderful to watch Malinga bowl, a low full toss, 138kmh, swings away a touch, Ojha just about manages to defend it

awesome from Malinga, what is a loosener he asks as he unleashes an inswinging yorker to crash into the base of middle and leg, Ingram had no clue about that one, no shame being dismissed by a ripper like that, 'Nailed' says the giant screen
sweeps an overpitched ball towards short fine leg

Harbhajan gets a wicket in the first wicket once more, that pitched on middle and straightens, Warner had a big stride in as he looked to defend, struck just above the knee roll, umpire Hariharan wastes little time lifting the finger, Warner walks off shaking his head, not sure he had much to complain about
once more Sehwag plays it uppishly, too far to the right of Harbhajan though
a touch short once more, Warner swivels as he whips the ball wide of mid-on
short ball on legstump, slapped to deep square leg for a single
whoah, that would have been a very short contest, the ball doesn't come on to the bat, and Sehwag pops up the ball nearly back to the bowler, just short of Harbhajan
